About Us

JBS Australia, part of the global JBS business, is the largest and most respected meat and food processor in Australia with a strong portfolio of leading beef, lamb, pork, salmon and value-added products. Our Northern division operates five beef processing plants across Queensland and Northern NSW, producing more than 400,000 tonnes of beef products every year.

Situated on 2,000ha, the JBS Riverina Plant is a part of the Riverina integrated farming, feedlot and processing operation. The cattle are walked from the feedlot to the plant, minimising stress and transportation costs, while simultaneously improving eating quality – one of only two in the southern hemisphere.

Based just outside Yanco, between the popular townships of Leeton and Narrandera in the heart of the Murrumbidgee Irrigation district (or Riverina region), our location ensures the ability to source high quality feeder cattle and grain to produce premium beef. The plant employs approximately 420 team members with a processing capacity of 600 head of cattle per day, operating 5 days per week.

About the Role

Are you an experienced Forklift with a passion for keeping things running smoothly? Join our dynamic team as a forklift driver in the bustling food production industry!

This is a full-time position with annual salary not less than $71,481.00 plus superannuation each year.

Key responsibilities include (but not limited to):

Operate forklift: Move, locate, relocate, stack, and count materials and merchandise within a warehouse, factory, or construction site.
Load and unload: Load and unload goods from vehicles like trucks and trailers.
Material handling: Stack, unstack, and store materials like boxes, crates, and pallets in designated areas.
Inventory management: Use radio frequency (RF) scanners to track inventory, pick orders, and maintain accurate inventory records.
Safety and maintenance: Perform daily safety checks on the forklift, report any defects or safety hazards, and ensure the equipment is clean and well-maintained.
Quality assurance: Check the condition of incoming and outgoing materials and ensure loads are properly stacked and secured.
Documentation: Complete forms, document the movement of goods, and handle paperwork like bills of lading.

About You

Forklift license is mandatory for operating a forklift, and VETASSESS certificate is a must.
Key skills include attention to detail, spatial awareness, and the ability to work well in a team.
A strong commitment to safety and understanding of safe operating practices and regulations is crucial.
More than one-year experience in the same environment.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment
The job requires the ability to operate the forklift for extended periods, which can involve sitting and standing
Good communication skills to collaborate effectively with team members
At JBS Riverina, your expertise is valued and rewarded! We provide:

Competitive salary range depending on experience
Shift allowances, overtime opportunities, and annual bonus eligibility.
On-site canteen plus heavily discounted meat products
Comprehensive training, career development pathways, and mentoring programs
JBS Riverina is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

The ad is valid for 28 days.

Interested? APPLY NOW

About us – Who are we? 
Bushland Health Group Limited is a long standing, community based, not for profit provider of residential aged care in the Manning Valley, on the mid north coast of NSW. We are the largest provider in the area and deliver best practice aged care to 269 residents across 3 homes.

 

About the Role – What will you do? 
You will be supported and empowered by our clinical staff that includes Registered Nurses, Nurse Educator and Nurse Practitioner to provide safe, innovative efficient and evidence-based nursing practice.

The role is focused around the care and treatment of older people living in residential aged care, who often have multiple comorbidities and include:

Diabetic Management
Wound Care
Pain Management
Palliative Care
Dementia Care
Heart Disease
Respiratory Disease
 

Graduate Program – What is our aim? 
Bushland Health Group’s Registered Nurse Transition Program has been introduced to offer newly graduated Registered Nurses a position within our organisation. We believe that care of the aged and disabled are specialties in their own right, where multi-disciplinary, high quality care is delivered professionally with compassion, understanding and integrity. We believe that each resident has unique biological, psychological, social and spiritual needs and the right to choose how those needs are met, thus enabling them to live their lives to the fullest and as independently as possible. We also believe in investing in the future of the aged care industry and developing first class clinicians and leaders who specialize in caring for older people

By participating in the program, you will not only develop your skills and confidence in caring holistically for older Australians but become part of a strong working and caring team who provide the highest level of residential aged care services in the Manning Valley.

The program will be conducted over a 12-month program with the potential to gain a permanent position at the completion.

 

Skills and Experience – What do you need?
Essential

A Registered Nurse, with current AHPRA registration
Flexible availability to work morning and afternoon shifts
Commitment to contemporary aged care practice with an understanding of the principles of person-centred care and dementia practice
Demonstrated commitment to quality improvement
Sound interpersonal and communication skills
Computer literacy
Desired

Experience in a clinical leadership role with the ability to manage day to day clinical issues
Demonstrated ability to lead, manage, and mentor staff to provide quality care outcomes for residents
Sound knowledge of ACFI and experience in resident assessment and care planning
 

Benefits and Perks – Why work with us? 
Not-for-profit salary sacrifice and tax-free benefits
Employee assistance program (EAP) to promote positive employee well being
Full time, part time and casual opportunities available
Salary and conditions are in accordance with the Bushland Health Group Limited, NSWNA and HSU NSW Enterprise Agreement 2017-2020
 

Still Interested – How do you apply? 
Submit your resume and cover letter addressing the above skills and experience required for the role.

Positions Available: Dairy Farm Positions

1. Dairy Farmers
Applicants must have at least a Bachelor’s Degree or 3 years of relevant experience.

2. Animal Husbandry Technicians
Applicants must have at least a Diploma or 3 years of relevant experience.

3. Senior Dairy Farm Operator
Applicants must have at least a relevant AQF Certificate III (or equivalent) and
At least one (1) year full-time of recent and relevant work experience.

4. Dairy Cattle Farm Operator
Applicants must have at least a relevant AQF certificate II or III (or equivalent) or
At least one (1) year full-time of recent and relevant work experience.

All applicants must meet the following criteria
·  Patient, Hardworking, Resourceful, Trustworthy, Loyal, Efficient
·  Understanding and passion for the Dairy industry
·  Previous experience in a similar role.
·  Constant monitoring of the Dairy Farm.
·  Sound knowledge in Farming Techniques and Management.
·  Demonstrate a broad and coherent body of knowledge of milk source and composition
· In-depth understanding of the safety and quality factors that determine the acceptability of dairy products by consumers.
· To be able to work and communicate effectively as part of a team.

Duties for Dairy Farmer:
· Supervision of Animal Husbandry and Feed Management.
· Managing all dairy cattle, heifers, dry cows, and calves
· Managing plant equipment and infrastructure maintenance
· Achieving agreed budgeted and physical performance targets
· Managing milk harvesting, milk quality and staff rosters
· Ensuring compliance with workplace and OH&S Legislation
· Adhering of Standard Operating Procedures (SOP)

Duties for Animal Husbandry  Technician:
· Assists Livestock Farmers and Farm Managers in breeding, raising livestock's.
· Nutrient Management Planning.
· Arranging supply of vaccines, mineral supplements, and other appropriate animal husbandry.
· Organize mating program for 2-year-old.
· Record all treatments to meet quality assurance requirements and farm policy. 
· Select cows for Artificial Insemination, assist with semen selection. Mark inseminated cows and keep insemination records. 
· Apply heat detection aids, identify, record, mark and draft cows on heat, segregate and prepare for insemination. 

Duties for Senior Dairy Cattle Farm Operators:
· Plan all aspects of milk production processes including management and coordination of milking shed routines;
· Coordinate and implement reproductive programs, including artificial insemination and herd fertility management, detection of oestrous and pregnancy;
· Assist in controlled breeding experiments to develop improved livestock strains;
· Implement calving procedures, including the ability to physically conduct unsupervised internal assessments to minimise the incidence of still births or injuries to cow or calf;
· Plan and manage pastures and crops for livestock production and develop livestock feeding plans.
· Analyse produce to set and maintain standards of quality;
· Supervise animal health programs, handle sick or injured animals and maintain an optimal environment for the
· Wellbeing of livestock consistent with the Australian Animal Welfare Standards and Guidelines – Cattle.

Duties for Dairy Cattle Farm Operators:
· Read and record instrument information i.e. Milk vat temperatures and cow numbers
· Undertake multiple functions, produce a quality outcome e.g. Farm machinery
· Operate milking plant and equipment.
· Operate standard measuring equipment
· Know general scientific terminology and assist with processes such as machine repair, artificial insemination, fertiliser mix design etc.
· Operate computerized system using menu options.

A remuneration package is between $71,481 to $95,000plus Superannuation will be negotiated depending on skills and experience.

Job Title: 		Pastry Cook
Salary range: 		$79,500 - $85,000
Job Closure date:	30 days

About the Role: Pastry Cook
This is a hands-on position at the heart of the bakery's daily production. You will be responsible for executing the core baking processes with precision and care, ensuring every item that reaches the customer is a testament to the bakery's commitment to quality. The role requires a collaborative spirit, a keen eye for detail, and a genuine passion for the art and science of baking.

Key Duties & Responsibilities
Ingredient Preparation & Dough Production:
• Meticulously check the quality of all raw materials and precisely weigh and measure ingredients to strict bakery formulations.
• Execute core baking techniques including kneading, maturing, cutting, moulding, mixing, and shaping a variety of doughs and pastries.
• Prepare a range of pastry fillings, ensuring consistency, flavour, and texture align with the bakery's artisanal standards.

Baking Process & Quality Control:
• Carefully monitor oven temperatures and visually track the baking process, making precise judgements on baking times to achieve perfect colour, rise, and texture.
• Coordinate the full baking sequence for batches—from forming and loading, through baking, to unloading, de-panning, and proper cooling.
• Apply finishing touches with care, including glazing buns and pastries, and decorating cakes with creams and icing.

Equipment Operation & Kitchen Stewardship:
• Operate and maintain specialized bakery machinery such as dough rollers, moulders, and biscuit cutters.
• Conduct thorough cleaning, greasing, and maintenance of all baking trays, tins, and equipment to the highest standards of hygiene and readiness.
• Begin each production shift by checking the cleanliness of equipment and the overall operation of the premises to ensure full compliance with all occupational health and safety regulations.

Skills & Experience 
• Previous 1-2 years’ experience in a bakery, pastry kitchen, or a fast-paced culinary production environment is highly valued.
• A foundational understanding of baking processes, ingredients, and food safety.
• The physical stamina to work in a production environment, including standing for extended periods and handling heavy trays.
• Exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to producing consistent, high-quality work.
• Excellent time-management skills and the ability to work effectively as part of a close-knit team.
• A positive, proactive attitude and a willingness to learn and grow within a supportive craft environment.

Our client offers a workplace that values diversity, inclusion, and the shared goal of creating exceptional food. If you are a team-oriented individual with a passion for the craft of baking, we would love to hear from you.

What Next?
If you are passionate about traditional baking and thrive in a fast-paced, hands-on environment, we would love to hear from you! Apply now to be part of a team that takes pride in crafting exceptional baked goods with care and expertise.

Please note: We are acting as the recruitment agent on behalf of our client, and the employer’s identity will be disclosed upon application.
